title: Lived experience of chronic depression: A qualitative comparative study of depression trajectories
summary: This study investigates how people with chronic depression (CD) experience their illness and how these experiences differ from those of people with acute depression (AD). Open-ended interviews will be used to explore personal experiences and perspectives on change and recovery. The findings aim to improve the understanding of individual experiences of depression across different trajectories and to complement existing research on chronic depression from a patient-centered perspective.

interventions.name: Patients with chronic depression (CD) (duration of depression/current depressive episode ≥ 24 months at the time of study participation)
Patients with acute depression (AD) (duration of depression/current depressive episode ≤ 6 months at the time of study participation)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Current diagnosis of depression (either for 24 months or longer or for 6 months or less), currently receiving treatment at the Department of Psychiatry, sufficient German language skills
Exclusion criteria:
Current diagnosis of bipolar disorder, personality disorder, substance use disorder, psychotic disorder, or severe cognitive impairment that would interfere with the ability to participate in a 60-minute conversation
